WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
station_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    avg_bandusagepct,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count * 1.0 / AVG(telescope_count) OVER () AS count_ratio
  FROM station_stats
)
SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, count_ratio
FROM station_ratios
ORDER BY count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
